2.why: LFNB.h:263-267 reads channel one only, into a scaler whose CV domain is -5..5 (AudioMath.h:109-121)

comment: This module has no manual. Param 8 carries the Extra Low Frequency menu item, which in this build only changes how many digits the frequency display shows: the DSP never reads it. The frequency figures come from the composite, where the knob maps to 2 to 14 and the filter runs at two to that power divided by four. In this build only the first channel is wired up: LFNB.h:255-267 reads the Fc and Q knobs, trims and CV inputs of channel one only, and channel two's filter is never configured, so its Fc and Q controls do nothing and its output runs at the default filter setting.
